Class AccountController

java.lang.Object
com.leap.leaplaughlove.account.account.AccountController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/account/accounts") public class AccountController extends Object
REST controller for managing accounts. Provides endpoints to retrieve account summaries and details for the authenticated client.

  • Constructor Details

    • AccountController

      public AccountController(AccountRepository accountRepository, AccountAuthorizationService accountAuthorizationService, AccountService accountService)
      Constructs an AccountController with the injected account repository, account authorization service and account service.
      Parameters:
      accountRepository - the repository used to access account data
      accountAuthorizationService - the service used to perform authorization checks on accounts
      accountService - the service used to open new accounts

  • Method Details

    • createAccount

      @PostMapping public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<AccountSummary> createAccount(@RequestBody(required=false) CreateAccountRequest request)
      Opens a new account for the authenticated client.
      Parameters:
      request - the creation request; the body may be omitted to default to USD
      Returns:
      the summary of the newly created account

    • getAccountsForClient

      @GetMapping public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<List<AccountSummary>> getAccountsForClient()
      Retrieves a list of account summaries for the authenticated client. Only accounts with ACTIVE status are included.
      Returns:
      a list of account summaries for the authenticated client

    • getAccount

      @GetMapping("/{accountId}") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<AccountSummary> getAccount(@PathVariable UUID accountId)
      Retrieves the summary of a specific account for the authenticated client.
      Parameters:
      accountId - the unique identifier of the account to retrieve
      Returns:
      the account summary for the specified account if it exists and belongs to the authenticated client
